prototypeScope: V1.33 delta package (mouth floor): one White plate with the head cap (two ears, no speaker collar, no amplifier posts) and the still unprinted V1.30 White parts (U20 face panel, A7Z roof saddle body and lid); one Yellow plate with the lower head shell (speaker pocket, twelve sound holes, amplifier rails, long-round exit); one Black plate with the jaw support (long-round exit). The unprinted V1.32 package (White and Yellow) and its drill template are superseded and not to be printed.
knownFitBoundary: Speaker pocket 0.2 mm clearance per side on the CMS-30204-18SP datasheet size (30 x 20), not a measured unit; the camera board passes 0.54 mm over the speaker on 0.3 mm tape and 0.76 mm over the amplifier. Amplifier rails 0.3 mm per side on the Adafruit board file width (17.78). INMP441 size from seller photos as V1.32. Printed sizes not measured.
processOverrideReason: V1.17 White overrides kept (3 support interface layers at 0.15 spacing, 0.2 top z, interface 40 mm/s, bridge 30 mm/s, support ironing, 0.2 first layer): the cap prints roof-down on tree support as V1.17 and V1.32, the saddle body on tree support as V1.30, the face flat without support. Yellow and Black: the donor profiles as is (as V1.30).
